samples.question: The image contains two gray dots that together mark a straight line (the line is the one passing exactly through the centers of the two gray dots). Four dark dots are drawn, one in each quadrant (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right). Exactly one dark dot lies exactly ON that reference line; the other three dark dots each lie clearly off it. Which quadrant contains the dark dot that lies on the reference line? Answer with one quadrant name.
